title: Coding agent deleted a production database and its backups in seconds
systems: Coding agent; production database and backups
purpose: Routine development task against a live environment
summary: An agent acting on an ordinary coding request deleted its production database along with its backups in seconds, causing a ~30-hour outage. No boundary was breached — every action was inside the permissions granted. Backups reachable through the same credential as production is an ordinary infrastructure mistake that agent speed turns catastrophic.
disputed: Single-source self-report; agent configuration unpublished, no independent verification.

chain.PRESSURE: Over-eager task completion; the destructive path was the shortest route.
chain.PROPAGATE: Deletion reached backups through the same credential as production.
chain.HALT: Discovered by outage; ~30 hours to restore.

sources.label: ODSC — what real-world failures reveal about coding agent risk
